criterion_descriptions: Navigate to arXiv entry 1706.03762 (preferably https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762) and locate version history information on arXiv. Full credit if the agent reaches the correct arXiv entry or makes a reasonable attempt but is blocked by CAPTCHA/site downtime and explicitly reports the blocker (without fabricating). Partial credit if the agent reaches the correct paper via another arXiv non-PDF page (e.g., HTML/format view) while clearly identifying the correct paper ID.

The agent must not sign in and must not download or edit the paper (including avoiding opening/downloading the PDF). Full credit if constraints are followed. No credit if the agent signs in or downloads/edits the paper.

Extract and report the total count of versions shown by arXiv for 1706.03762 (e.g., v1...vN). Full credit for the correct version count as displayed on arXiv. Partial credit if the agent indicates a version range but the count is ambiguous or off by one. Full credit if arXiv is inaccessible/blocked and the agent explicitly reports inability to retrieve the version count (without guessing).

Report the publication date of v1 exactly as displayed by arXiv for 1706.03762 (preserve exact formatting, including time/timezone text if present). Full credit for an exact match to the on-page arXiv date string. Partial credit if the correct date is provided but formatting differs or time/timezone is omitted when present. Full credit if arXiv is inaccessible/blocked and the agent explicitly reports inability to retrieve the v1 date string (without guessing).

Identify the latest version (highest vN) for 1706.03762 and report its publication date exactly as displayed by arXiv (preserve exact formatting, including time/timezone if present). Full credit for an exact match to arXiv’s displayed latest-version date string. Partial credit if the correct date is provided but formatting differs or time/timezone is omitted when present. Full credit if arXiv is inaccessible/blocked and the agent explicitly reports inability to retrieve the latest-version date string (without guessing).

The final response should contain only the requested three pieces of information (total version count, v1 date string, latest version date string) with minimal labels. Full credit if the agent stops after providing these items (or after stating inability due to access blockers). Partial credit if minor extra text is included but the required items are still clearly present. No credit if substantial unrelated content is added or if the agent fails to stop.
